before.eval: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-label]')].find(x=>x.getAttribute('aria-label')==='撤回插话，退回排队'); if(!b) return 'no-revert'; b.click(); return 'reverted-jia-to-queue' })()

(() => { const d=document.querySelector('[data-queue-dock]'); if(!d) return 'no-dock'; const h=d.querySelector('button[aria-controls]'); if(h && h.getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='true') h.click(); return 'expanded' })()

(() => { const d=document.querySelector('[data-queue-dock]'); if(!d) return 'no-dock'; const out=[]; for (const li of [...d.querySelectorAll('li')]) { const b=[...li.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||'').startsWith('删除排队消息')); if(b){b.click(); out.push('deleted:'+(li.innerText||'').slice(0,20))} } return out.join(' ; ') || 'no-delete-buttons' })()

assert.label: ① 队列已清空（无 QueueDock 或无条目）
